findings.problem: Reference expiry/revocation rejects new authorization but the observation path for an already-started execution is not defined.
findings.required_change: Separate observation from new-side-effect verification, persist an authorized execution binding snapshot, allow current-authorized provider observation/finalization after expiry or revocation, and forbid every new write retry unless all current checks pass.

findings.problem: Execution acquire/observe/finalize and stale takeover do not declare typed CAS predicates, authoritative clock, fencing results or complete fingerprint fields.
findings.required_change: Add typed ToolActionStore execution contracts with owner/deadline/generation/revision, PostgreSQL clock, exact CAS outcomes and complete provider-intent fingerprint reused by every retry.
Define a closed terminal provider-failure enum and deterministic unknown-code behavior that cannot create a false definitive outcome.
